content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Alpharetta

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Review PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Alpharetta professionals in technology, healthcare, and logistics typically meet these standards. Gather documentation of your work history and formal education to prepare for application.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our courses are designed for working professionals and align with PMI's mandatory education requirement. Complete all sessions, participate actively, and retain your course certificate for your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and submit your official PMP application with proof of education and experience. Pay the examination fee through PMI's portal. PMI will review and approve your application, typically within two weeks of submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours. Schedule your exam through Pearson VUE at a testing center or proctored online. Sit for the computer-based exam and receive your results immediately upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy courses, conference attendance, and project leadership all qualify. Renew your credential before expiration by submitting proof of PDUs and the renewal fee to PMI.
